title: IIS application pools have no periodic recycling triggers
description: Exchange server IIS application pools SHOULD NOT use periodic time, schedule, memory, or request-count recycling triggers. The OWA and ECP application pools are exempt only from the periodic time-based check.
subject: Server

remediation.description: Review each reported IIS application pool and its recycling conditions with the Exchange administrator. Remove only unintended recycling triggers after assessing operational impact; do not change OWA/ECP time-based settings based on this control alone.

considerations: Only Exchange-owned application pools assigned to applications in the Default Web Site and Exchange Back End are evaluated. Unrelated pools are excluded. Both sites and their OWA/ECP applications must be present, and recognized Exchange applications must reference Exchange-owned pools; unresolved scope is Unknown. Effective IIS provider settings include inherited applicationPoolDefaults, schema defaults, and schedule overrides. OWA/ECP pools are exempt only from the time-based condition; the other four conditions still apply. Incomplete, legacy raw-XML, or malformed pool evidence is Unknown.
